failure_mode: Flexspline tooth-flank fretting wear with micro-pitting
mechanism: Micro-oscillation keeps the contact in the boundary regime; the entrained film cannot reform between reversals, so asperity contact accumulates fretting damage.
failure_diagnosis: The flexspline flank records material loss at the oscillation reversal zones while the bulk tooth form is intact: a boundary-regime contact-fatigue state, not a bulk load failure.
root_cause_hypotheses: Hypothesis: Grease base-oil bleed rate is too low to replenish the reversal zones between micro-oscillations.
Hypothesis: Thickener soap-fiber structure is sheared out of the contact under sustained micro-oscillation.
lubricant_contribution: POSSIBLE - Pending SRV fretting bench verification of base-oil bleed rate and soap-fiber shear stability.
